result.keywords: This study presents a compact modular platform that combines low-cost EEG acquisition with stackable soft-robotics-inspired hardware units for flexible sensing and signal routing. Target applications include brain-computer interfaces, rehabilitation, educational demonstrations, and portable research setups. The design emphasizes reusable connection mechanisms, battery operation, configurable channel counts from 16 to 48, sampling rates between 250 Hz and 800 Hz, and wireless data transfer over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi. Evaluation focuses on signal integrity, interface stability, and practical deployment in constrained environments, showing a viable path toward adaptable physiological sensing systems.
result.title: A Modular Soft Board for Low-Cost EEG Acquisition and Signal Routing
